errors.evidence: This description of the vertical axis is presented as if it applies to both sets of bars. However, this axis and scale only correspond to the blue bars (absolute number of cars). It does not apply to the brown bars, which represent percentages and whose values (e.g., 2.9, 10.7) are not read from this axis. The description fails to clarify that this is a primary axis for only one of the two data series shown.
The description omits that the horizontal axis has a placeholder label reading 'Axis Title'.
